calls.title: GrowthBook / Everything Financial UK
calls.summary: The team convened to outline a strategy for product adoption, starting with the Pro plan to demonstrate immediate value for level one and two users. This approach aims to avoid high upfront costs and lengthy processes, with the Enterprise features slated for later stages. Discussion also included a flexible pricing strategy, projecting a three to six-month timeline before Enterprise features become necessary due to compliance and use case growth. Four proof of concepts are planned for execution, expected to generate results within three weeks, followed by a checkpoint in 90 days. The team acknowledged the need for stakeholder engagement, especially considering a key stakeholder's temporary absence, while emphasizing communication to ensure continuity. A new AI-powered visual editor is being beta-tested to enhance usability for non-technical users, with early access offered to facilitate user feedback.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Pro vs Enterprise, Compliance, Proof of Concept, Experimentation, AI-powered editor
